 Panthers Host Coastal for Halloween Showdown
 10/26/2026 11:00:00 AM 
 Share:
 Story Links
 GEORGIA STATE (4-3, 1-2 SBC) vs COASTAL CAROLINA (2-5, 1-2 SBC) 
 Saturday, Oct. 31 | 2:00 p.m. ET | Atlanta, Ga. 
 TV:  ESPN+ 
 RADIO:  Georgia State Radio Network in Atlanta on WRAS-FM 88.5, in Gainesville on WGTJ-FM 97.5, GSU Athletics mobile app,  www.LowCountryRadio.com 
 ---
ATLANTA-- After a two-game road swing, Georgia State returns home to face Coastal Carolina in a Halloween matchup on Saturday, Oct. 31 at 2:00p.m., the first game in Center Parc Credit Union since the first weekend in October.  
 The Panthers are 4-3 on the season, matching the best start in program history dating back to the 2023 when Georgia State went 4-0 to begin the season and continued to a 6-1 record through seven games.
 In just seven games this season, head coach Dell McGee has already matched his win total from his first two seasons combined at Georgia State. After recording four victories across the 2024 and 2025 campaigns, McGee has guided the Panthers to a 4-1 start in 2026, matching his previous two-year win total before the midway point of the season.
 Georgia State is averaging 35.9 points and 449.3 yards of total offense per game through seven contests, including 205.3 rushing yards and 244.0 passing yards per game.
 The Panthers continue to dominate on the ground, outrushing opponents 1,437-1,045, while holding a 14-13 advantage in rushing touchdowns. Georgia State is averaging 5.4 yards per carry, compared to 4.5 yards per attempt by its opponents.
 Georgia State opened conference play with a 42-10 Homecoming win over Old Dominion, highlighted by Cameran Brown's program-record six touchdown passes and a defensive effort that held the Monarchs to a program-low 146 yards of total offense. The Panthers also tied the program record with seven sacks, while Xavier Esqillion matched the individual single-game record with three sacks.
 Georgia State opened the season with a 59-10 win over North Carolina A&T on Sept. 4, setting the program record for most points scored in a game, largest margin of victory and second fewest points allowed in program history. 
 SERIES HISTORY 
 Georgia State and Coastal Carolina are meeting for the 10th time in program history and the fifth on home territory. The Panthers look for their first win at home against the Chanticleers.  
 PROTECTING THE PARC 
 Georgia State is a perfect 3-0 at home this season with wins over N.C. A&T, Northern Illinois and Old Dominion.
 The Panthers have outscored those three opponents 136-34, an average margin of 34.0 points per game.
 GSU has scored at least 35 points in all three home games while holding every home opponent to 14 points or fewer.
 Georgia State is averaging 45.3 points per game at Center Parc Credit Union Stadium while allowing just 11.3 points per contest.
 The Panthers have scored 18 touchdowns across their three home games, including eight in the season-opening 59-10 win over N.C. A&T.
 LEADING THE SUN BELT 
 Georgia State's offense leads the Sun Belt in 3rd down conversions (0.457) conversion percentage. They are also second in the Sun Belt in total offense, averaging 449.3 yards per game.
 The offensive line leads the conference and are 13th in the nation in fewest sacks allowed (1.0 pg). They are second in the conference in fewest tackles for loss allowed (4.0 pg)
 Georgia State's defense leads the SBC and ranks 12th in the nation in team sacks (3.0 pg). They also lead the conference in fewest first downs allowed (127). 
 The Panthers' special teams leads the conference and ranks seventh in the nation in blocked punts (1). 
 UP NEXT 
 Georgia State opens November action on the road in Boone, N.C., to face Appalachian State on Saturday, Nov.  7.
